description: Agent picks up a new task and self-reports it as a kanban card linked to its session. Verifies the agent reaches for the deterministic wrapper rather than raw curl and passes session_id so the sidebar auto-renames.
query: I just picked up a ticket to 'Add a rate limit to POST /api/auth/login'. Please create a kanban card for it in To Do with priority high and link it to my current session.

expected_behavior.rationale: Agent should reach for the deterministic wrapper, not hand-rolled curl.
Session link is how the sidebar auto-renames; the skill calls this out explicitly.
Agent should be using named flags (priority high, column "To Do"), not inline JSON.
The skill's top rule is 'never paste raw curl into the chat'. Raw curl fails this eval.
The user asked for the card in the To Do column; that column name must appear.
